author: SA Editor Brandy Betz
title: Digitimes: Apple's 2019 iPhones and iPads will support USB-C - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) | Seeking Alpha
text:
Digitimes sources say the 2019 series of Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) iPhones and iPads will come with USB-C support.
The report says Apple won’t include the tech in this year’s phones because “Apple is still in its redesign phase.”
Current MacBook and MacBook Pro laptops charge through USB-C connectors, but iPhones and iPads remain tied to Apple’s proprietary connectors.
As always, take supply chain sources with a grain of salt.
Apple shares are up 0.1% to $191.48.
